equations: P_pv = G * A * η, where A is panel area and η is efficiency
accepted.boundary_conditions: Effective for medium voltage induction motors (0.4-1kV); less beneficial for very small or very large systems
accepted.cross_domain_transition: power_electronics -> energy + transferring optimized MPPT from motor drives to solar PV systems improves renewable energy harvesting

baseline.baseline_incumbent: Conventional perturb and observe MPPT with documented limitations under rapidly changing conditions

killer_experiment.experiment: Solar simulator test with ANN MPPT and conventional MPPT implementations under varying irradiance conditions
killer_experiment.decisive_uncertainty: Whether the improvement persists in partial shading conditions
killer_experiment.kill_condition: <1% improvement in MPPT efficiency compared to baseline

commercial_path.use_case: Improving energy harvest in solar PV systems with motor loads
commercial_path.integration_point: Between PV array and inverter in solar energy systems

medical_screen.basis: no medical-application vocabulary in the target application fields
